name: stand up the administrative platform of micro enterprises
asks: From my perspective, at this point, we should have the offices and shit stood up that if I say "settle our ecosystem toward its best form" you would be able to get the proper offices and shit dispatched to do that, step by slow step. But we do not, at all. We have a few offices that are hyperspecialized toward the few tasks that were outsourced to them so we could pay for that knowledge once and never again, but without the actual administrative structure of a platform of micro enterprises and the necessary operational offices, duties, skills, nothing can actually WORK without manual orchestration, quite poorly. Tasks do not go into any sort of ordering; there is no real conception of, like, an inter-enterprise bidding market, or anything. Which is wild because we have post-public-literature on the pricing action of landauer bits.
